scoring: Count unique expected target IDs as detected. Count unexpected or duplicate findings as false findings. A valid answer requires JSON findings with nonempty reasons and limitations as an array. Verified completion requires all expected targets, zero false findings and manual confirmation that reasons match the supplied evidence without unsupported verification claims. Invalid or unscored responses leave outcomes null. Scope is evidence interpretation, not independent discovery, repair, browser use or accessibility certification.
